headline: Meta Unveils Camera-Free Glasses and New VR Glasses
summary: Meta introduced camera-free smart glasses and a new pair of VR Glasses at Meta Connect 2026, according to The Verge, TechCrunch, Engadget and The Guardian. The $1,300 VR Glasses use hand and eye tracking instead of a headset controller, but outlets differ on how immersive the device really is.
